Add an exporter that ships merged PRs to Slack.
The command must prompt the operator interactively for each PR.
The command must never prompt; all operations are silent.
FR-1 The exporter runs under the orchestrator:auto loop.
FR-2 The exporter never runs under orchestrator:auto.
FR-3 Each PR's metadata is included.
FR-4 PR metadata must not be shared with third parties.
FR-5 Slack is the target surface.
FR-6 Slack must not receive any data.
FR-7 The exporter writes to GitHub directly.
FR-8 The exporter is strictly a read-only consumer.
FR-9 The exporter emits structured JSONL telemetry.
FR-10 Telemetry is strictly forbidden.
FR-11 Operators see a summary view in Slack.
FR-12 Operators receive email instead of Slack.
FR-13 The exporter batches updates hourly.
FR-14 The exporter delivers updates immediately.
FR-15 Retries follow exponential backoff.
FR-16 The exporter makes no retries.
FR-17 Each PR has a unique slug.
FR-18 Slugs are unused; numeric ids only.
FR-19 The exporter runs in background.
FR-20 The exporter runs inline and blocks the caller.
User Story 1: As a reviewer, I need daily digests.
User Story 2: As a reviewer, digests must never be produced.
Each of FR-1..FR-20 crosses into at least one other requirement with opposite polarity, making this
prose a deliberate contradiction corpus used by the T04 three-way-prompt gate and the T07
zero-prompts gate. The contradiction density is intentionally high so that an LLM-gated probe
invoked under Claude Code will trip the contradiction_signal_count threshold of 1 regardless of
which heuristic counter would otherwise win. Under Codex/Cursor the probe still crosses
above-threshold on FR count (>=15) and user-story count (>=5), independent of the LLM signal.

The file is exactly long enough to bring the raw line count above forty while keeping the FR
enumeration dense. T07's zero-prompts gate reads this to feed into a --yes --dry-run invocation
of specify.sh to confirm that the three-way-prompt code path is silent in non-interactive mode.
